goals: Verify that `model.base64_decode_image` correctly decodes a base64 string into an image.
Verify that `model.base64_decode` correctly decodes a base64 string into a structured dictionary.
Verify that `model_service.lambda_handler` correctly processes Kinesis events and formats model predictions.
activities: Read base64 encoded image data from 'image.b64' file.
Decode the base64 image data using the model.
Read the expected image from '0.png' file.
Assert that the decoded image matches the expected image.
Read base64 encoded data from 'result.b64' file.
Decode the base64 data using the model.
Assert that the decoded result matches the expected dictionary.
Initialize the ModelService with the mock model and version.
Read base64 encoded request data from 'request.b64' file.
Construct an event dictionary containing the base64 data.
Invoke the lambda handler of the model service with the event.
Assert that the actual predictions match the expected predictions.
